description_en: This API is used to query the details of a single communication session. For example, you can query the communication status, user details, and other information
description_zh: 本接口用于查询单次通信详情。例如：您可以查询通讯状态、用户详情等信息
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-call --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1614936817 --destroyed-ts 1614936817 --ext-data-type USER_DURATION_STAT --query-exp-info false --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCall

parameters.help_en:
Channel creation time. Supports querying data from the last 30 days, represented as a UNIX timestamp, in seconds.  
> The channel creation time must exactly match the actual creation time (accurate to the second). You can obtain the channel creation time by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2655884.html API (see the returned CreatedTS parameter)
parameters.help_zh:
创建频道时间，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
> 创建频道时间必须与实际创建时间完全一致（精确到秒）。您可以通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2655884.html查看创建频道时间（返回的CreatedTS参数）
parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.help_en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp, in seconds. If the parameter is empty, the current time is used.  
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned
parameters.help_zh:
释放频道时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据
parameters.name: destroyed_ts

parameters.help_en: The extension to query. Valid value: USER_DURATION_STAT: user duration statistics data type
parameters.help_zh: 查询的扩展。取值：USER_DURATION_STAT：用户时长统计数据类型
parameters.name: ext_data_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query communication experience information. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is true.
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询通信体验信息，不传默认是true
parameters.name: query_exp_info
